title: Extract one archive-with-reconciliation helper shared by manual Archive and the terminal release ticket
outcome: Found by review pair 5 (Claude reviewer, 2026-09-11). archive_codex_thread (src/codex_thread_actions.rs:211) is a ~200-line function around an immediately-invoked closure whose three flags (archive_attempted, rejected, confirmed_not_archived) decide the CodexReleaseOutcome; the same classification is duplicated almost verbatim in CodexDelegationReleaseTicket::start (src/codex_delegation_release.rs:261-310). The two copies must stay identical for the fencing to be correct and can drift. TASK: extract a single helper in codex_delegation_release.rs that performs the archive RPC plus archived/active reconciliation and returns the outcome and an optional ApiError; call it from both the manual and the automatic path; pure refactor with the existing tests green. Post-landing follow-up.
